No — not through this chat. I can't receive file uploads or attachments here, and I have no filesystem or repository access. All I'm given for this turn is the deck scope (`brandon-japanese-genki-ii-lesson-13-potential-...`), any earlier messages, and what you type.

A couple of things worth separating:

- **Adding or changing Japanese study content** never happens in conversation. It has to be prepared as an explicit revision proposal in the separate `revise` pass, which you review and approve before anything is written. Asking about it here doesn't start that.

- **Whether janki itself has an import path** — bulk vocab list, CSV, pasted source text, etc. — I genuinely don't know. That's a property of your app that wasn't supplied to me, so I'd be guessing if I answered.

What I can do right now is talk through the material with you: what potential-form patterns Lesson 13 should cover, which verbs or example sentences you want represented, how you'd want prompts phrased. If you paste text into a message, I can discuss it and help you shape it — but turning it into cards is still a separate reviewed step.

If you can tell me how you normally get new source material into janki, I can work within that.
